description: Resolve the bridge route for a token between two networks: the OFT contract, whether the direction is enabled right now, the fee, and — if amount and recipient are given — a ready-to-sign transaction (plus an ERC-20 approval transaction when the token bridges through a separate adapter). This tool NEVER signs or sends; it returns transactions for a human or wallet to review and sign.

amount.description: Human-readable amount to bridge, e.g. "12.5". Required to build a transaction.

decimals.description: Token decimals. Read automatically if omitted; pass explicitly to be certain.

oftContract.description: Optional: the OFT contract address, if you already know it (skips discovery).

recipient.description: Recipient address on the destination network (also the refund address). Required to build a transaction.

name: find_bridge_route
